newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Research Council to debate the 5th framework programme.
newsitem.headline: Research Council to debate the 5th framework programme.

text.p: Monday's Research Council is due to discuss the outlines of the Fifth Framework Programme for Research and Development, research into mad-cow disease and the possibilities of finding more cash for the current framework programme.

Talks in Luxembourg on the Fifth Framework Programme will centre on Research Commissioner Edith Cresson's communication of July 14. In this, she highlighted as priority research areas biotechnologies, health care, environmental protection, technologies ensuring greater mobility and to prevent damage to health and the environment.

Cresson also wants research ministers to approve research funds worth 50 million Ecus to look into Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy and prion diseases affecting humans, including the BSE-equivalent Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease.

Ministers will discuss during lunch, that is to say behind closed doors without officials, the Commission's January proposal to bump up the funds available for the existing, Fourth Framework Programme for Research and Development.
ECOFIN, which holds the purse strings, is due to decide what money, if any, is available during its meeting on October 14.
Cresson will also present her ideas on the Innovation Green Paper of December last year as well as the action plan on the information society adopted by the European Commission only last week.
